questions.q: In what order do you tune a plane in ArduPlane?
questions.explain: Inner loops before outer ones: bad pitch looks like bad TECS.

questions.q: How do you check control surface reversals before a flight in FBWA?
options: Wiggle the sticks in MANUAL and watch the surfaces
Tilt the plane: the surfaces counteract
Look at the throttle level in the log
questions.explain: In a stabilized mode the surfaces must counter the tilt; getting it wrong means a crash on launch.

questions.q: When does AUTOTUNE save P and D?
questions.explain: P and D — when an axis finishes, FF and I — when you exit the mode.

options: The maximum aileron servo speed in °/s
The time constant of the roll response
questions.explain: Within τ the plane covers ~63 % of the requested angle; 0.5 s by default.

options: Calculate it from weight, thrust and wing area
Measure the climb at THR_MAX in FBWA
questions.explain: TECS limits are measured with test flights; for electric planes — at the end of the battery.

questions.q: Altitude oscillates in LOITER, pitch is tuned. What do you adjust?
questions.explain: Altitude oscillation is fixed with TECS_TIME_CONST, then TECS_PTCH_DAMP.

questions.q: The plane weaves after every turn in AUTO. What do you do?
questions.explain: Weaving means L1 is too sharp; sluggish turns are the opposite — decrease by 5.

questions.q: Why do you install a rangefinder for auto landing?
options: The barometer doesn't work at low altitude
questions.explain: A baro error of a few meters makes the flare a lottery; RNGFND_LANDING = 1 makes it repeatable.
